english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for something that is annoying or irritating.
This is the all-purpose choice for something that annoys or bothers you, such as bureaucracy or a person.
Use this especially when the emphasis is on irritation or something getting on your nerves.
Choose this when the annoyance feels like being bothered, troubled, or fed up rather than openly angry.
Use this when the tiresome thing is irritating, troublesome, or repeatedly bothersome.
Use this when the wearisome thing is troublesome or irritating, such as repetitive procedures or paperwork.
Use this when stupid means irritating or troublesome rather than lacking intelligence.

examples.english: You are so annoying that I can't get anything done.
examples.traditional: 你咁煩，搞到我做唔到嘢。
examples.jyutping: nei5 gam3 faan4 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 zou6 m4 dou2 je5

examples.jyutping: gaau2 ni1 di1 sau2 zuk6 zan1 hai6 faan4

examples.english: The noise from the air conditioner next door is really bothersome.
examples.traditional: 隔籬部冷氣機嘈到我好煩。

examples.english: These phone calls have really annoyed me lately.
